name: Lawful of Passion
source:
You are Melborn, a law student from Brazil who emigrated to Norway and is now about to start their first internship at a real law firm! 

However, as excited as you are, you are also very nervous about messing up. Thankfully, your supervisor is there to guide you, and she's also really pretty…

Your college best friend is also by your side during these times, however, you can easily see through his lack of enthusiasm, and although that's a running theme for him, you are still a bit worried about what's on his mind.

[From [url=https://beskyttet.itch.io/lawful-of-passion]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是梅尔伯恩，一名从巴西移居挪威的法学院学生，如今即将在一家真正的律师事务所开启人生第一份实习工作！

然而在满怀兴奋的同时，你也生怕自己搞砸一切而紧张不已。所幸你的实习导师会一直在旁悉心指导——而且她本人还漂亮得让人移不开眼……

你的大学死党在这段日子里也一直陪在你身边；不过你一眼就能看穿他兴致缺缺的模样——尽管他向来都是这副没精打采的脾气，你还是忍不住有些担心他心里究竟藏着什么烦心事。

[摘自[url=https://beskyttet.itch.io/lawful-of-passion]itch.io[/url]]
